name: realestate-marketplace
description: Full-stack real estate marketplace: React + Vite frontend, Express + MongoDB API, real-time messaging with Socket.IO

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
